text: Started my PhD at the ELLIS Institute Tübingen / Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems!
Our work, A Realistic Threat Model for Large Language Model Jailbreaks, has been accepted for an oral presentation at the Red Teaming GenAI Workshop at NeurIPS 2024.
Our work, ASIDE: Architectural Separation of Instructions and Data in Language Models, has been accepted for an oral presentation at the BuildingTrust Workshop at ICLR 2025.
Our work, An Interpretable N-gram Perplexity Threat Model for Large Language Model Jailbreaks, has been accepted at ICML 2025.
Capability-Based Scaling Laws for LLM Red-Teaming accepted at ICML 2025 Workshop on Reliable and Responsible Foundation Models!
Kristina Nikolić, Evgenii Kortukov, and I won third place at the ARENA 6.0 Mechanistic Interpretability Hackathon by Apart Research in LISA (London)!
I will join MATS 9.0 cohort as a part of GDM stream (Zimmermann/Lindner/Emmons/Jenner) focusing on red-teaming of white-box detectors!
Happy to share that four out of four of my submissions got accepted into ICLR 2026! Shoot me an email if you want to catch up in Rio!
Our work, Measuring Control Intervention Awareness Across Frontier LLMs, has been accepted for an oral presentation at the CAO Workshop at ICLR 2026!
Claudini: Autoresearch Discovers State-of-the-Art Adversarial Attack Algorithms for LLMs has been accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond!
Training Against Harmfulness Probes Induces Harmlessness without Refusals has been accepted at the ICML 2026 MechInterp Workshop!
